fullDescription:
New Year’s Eve Digital Planner Stickers is a set of fun, photobooth-style stickers to commemorate New Year’s Eve in your planner!

WHAT’S INCLUDED in New Year’s Eve Digital Planner Stickers:

– 38 planner stickers, as shown in the previews, for use with any digital planner or app.
– A hyperlinked sticker book for GoodNotes users. This .goodnotes file contains all the stickers already placed for you. (Works with GoodNotes 5).
– A zipped file with individual PNGs, placement guides, and a bonus blank hyperlinked PDF sticker book for users of other apps such as Notability, Noteshelf, Zoom Notes, etc.
– Includes the color hex codes.
– Files are 150 DPI and are not suitable for printing. (This is so that your iPad/tablet isn’t slowed down by large files.)
– Can be used with any digital planner.
– Your completed purchase order will include a download of a single .ZIP file containing all the above-mentioned contents.

PLEASE NOTE: This is a digital download – you will not receive a physical product.
